pages.en:
Sung Yah Shing (孙亚兴)
Nanking                                      D.S.I. Crighton
Police Hqrs.        24/7/38                  D.S.I. Liao Chang-chien

My name is Sung Yah Shing (孙亚兴) alias Yue Tseng
Zang (于增人), alias Yue Kuang (于光). I am 27 years
old, single, unemployed. I have no permanent address in
Shanghai.

My mother is a native of Chinkiang. She has never
resided in Shanghai.

My father who died in 1934, was prior to his death was
engaged in piece goods trade in Shanghai, Chinkiang, and
Nanking. He visited Shanghai only at intervals but never
remained permanently resident.

I was born in the city of Chinkiang in the province of
Kiangsu on the 20th January, 1912. At the age of 6 or 7
years I went to study at the 1st Primary School, Chinkiang,
and remained there until I had attained the age of 11 years.
I then went to Nanking where I studied under a private tutor
named Sung Su Shih (孙教锡) for three years. At the age of
14 years I came to Shanghai with my father and lived with
an aunt who was then living at the corner of Nanking Road
and Hankow Road. This house has since been demolished.
At this time I joined the Tung Wei Primary School, Amoy Road,
where I studied for 6 months. I then went to Hankow for
1 year, where I studied at the Shing Sung (兴盛) Middle
School. Returning to Shanghai my father put me into the
shop of a friend to learn the watch trade. During this time
I studied at the Nanking Road Supplementary Evening School.
Four years later I completed my apprenticeship and opened a
watch shop named Shing Heng (興亨) at Foochow Road.
pages.zh:
Sung Yah Shing（孙亚兴）
南京                                      副督察长 Crighton
警察总局        1938年7月24日                  副督察长 Liao Chang-chien

我叫 Sung Yah Shing（孙亚兴），别名 Yue Tseng Zang（于增人），别名 Yue Kuang（于光）。我27岁，未婚，失业。我在上海没有固定住址。

我母亲是镇江人。她从未在上海居住过。

我父亲于1934年去世，生前在上海、镇江和南京从事布匹贸易。他只是偶尔去上海，从未长期定居。

我于1912年1月20日出生在江苏省镇江市。六七岁时，我进入镇江第一小学读书，一直读到11岁。随后我去了南京，在一位名叫 Sung Su Shih（孙教锡）的家庭教师门下学习了三年。14岁时，我随父亲来到上海，与当时住在南京路和汉口路拐角处的一位姑妈同住。那所房子后来已被拆除。当时我进入了厦门路的同维小学，在那里学习了六个月。之后我去汉口待了一年，在兴盛中学读书。回到上海后，父亲把我送到一位朋友的店里学习钟表行业。在此期间，我在南京路补习夜校学习。四年后，我出师并在福州路开设了一家名为“興亨”的钟表店。

pages.en:
- 2 -

In September 1931 when the Japanese captured Mukden, I closed
my shop and joined the Shanghai Citizens' Volunteer Corps
with a view to serving my country in a more beneficial manner.
This Corps was in charge of Wang Ping Nan (王彬南),
a lawyer, its headquarters being established on the 2nd floor
of the Tseng Dah Silk and Satin Shop, Foochow Road and Pekien
Road corner. There were altogether 500 persons in this Corps
In the middle of October, 1931, all the members of the
Corps, including myself, were sent to undergo military train-
ing in the public recreation ground on Dah Chih Road, Kuntse.
On January 28, 1932, the Sino-Japanese hostilities broke
out in Shanghai. Approximately 300 of the members of the
Corps pledged their willingness of participating in the war
and were transported on about January 30 to Paoshan under the
command of Wang Ping Nan, I being then a section commander.
On arriving at Paoshan we were drafted into the 196th Brigade
of the Chinese Army under the command of Gen. Ong Zhao Wu
(翁照垣). We, the volunteer corps members, assisted the
army in defending the area and fought once against the
Japanese. In the clash about 30 of our colleagues were
killed.
In March, 1932, we, in accordance with the instructions
from Gen. Ong Zhao Wu, withdrew to Sungkiang, and soon
afterwards an armistice was concluded between Japan and China.
While in Sungkiang we underwent further and more rigid
military training. In May or June, 1932, the 19th Route
Army to which the volunteer corps was attached, was transferred
pages.zh:
- 2 -

1931年9月，日军占领沈阳时，我关闭了店铺，加入了上海市民义勇军，以期以更有利的方式报效国家。该义勇军由律师王彬南（Wang Ping Nan）负责，总部设在福州路与北京路拐角的曾大绸缎庄二楼。该义勇军共有500人。1931年10月中旬，包括我在内的所有队员被送往昆山路（Kuntse）大智路公共游乐场接受军事训练。1932年1月28日，中日战事在上海爆发。约300名队员宣誓参战，并于1月30日左右在王彬南的指挥下被运往宝山，我当时担任排长。抵达宝山后，我们被编入翁照垣将军指挥的中国军队第196旅。我们义勇军队员协助军队防守该地区，并与日军交战一次。在那次冲突中，我们约有30名同伴阵亡。
1932年3月，根据翁照垣将军的命令，我们撤至松江，不久后中日达成停战协议。在松江期间，我们接受了进一步且更严格的军事训练。1932年5月或6月，义勇军所属的第19路军奉蒋介石将军命令调往

pages.en:
- 3 -
to Pekien by order of Gen. Chiang Kai Shek, and the Corps
was disbanded. I returned to Shanghai and organized a
Chun Yin (Mutual Benefit) Society in Rue Palikao (No. not
remembered) with a view to promoting the political knowledge
of the members. The Society had about 50 members consisting
of persons of various walks of life. However, owing to
financial difficulties, the Society closed at the beginning
of 1933, when I established a Hwa Shing Exchange Shop at the
corner of Rue Ratard and Rue des Soeurs with a capital of about
$2,000.00 which I obtained from my mother then residing in
Hankow. My family owns estate property in Hankow valued at
approximately $10,000.00.
While I was conducting my shop, some of the former
members of the Shanghai Citizens' Volunteer Corps, including
Liang Tung Fang (梁桐芳) and Tsai Wei Fang (蔡偉芳),
organized "anti-traitors societies" in Shanghai. Apparently
these societies had for their aim the salvation of the
nation but actually they were utilized by Liang Tung Fang,
Tsai Wei Fang, and others as a means to extort money from
certain merchants who were dealing in Japanese goods for the
maintenance of their livelihood. I despised them and did
not participate in the alleged anti-traitor activities.
In Summer 1933, I closed my shop owing to business
depression and went to Li-s with my friend, Wang Tsung Ming
(王宗明), a student of the Hupeh College, (at present in
Hankow), at the Peking Railway Station, Rue Auguste Hauss.
I do not remember the number of the room. Owing to my
pages.zh:
- 3 -
北京，义勇军随之解散。我回到上海，在贝勒路（Rue Palikao，门牌号不记得）组织了一个“春阴”（互助）社，旨在提高成员的政治知识。该社约有50名成员，由各界人士组成。然而，由于资金困难，该社于1933年初关闭，当时我在拉塔德路（Rue Ratard）与修女路（Rue des Soeurs）拐角处开设了一家“华兴”兑换店，资本约为2,000美元，这笔钱来自当时居住在汉口的母亲。我家在汉口拥有价值约10,000美元的房地产。
在我经营店铺期间，一些前上海市民义勇军成员，包括梁桐芳（Liang Tung Fang）和蔡偉芳（Tsai Wei Fang），在上海组织了“反奸团”。显然，这些社团的目标是救国，但实际上被梁桐芳、蔡偉芳等人利用，作为向某些经营日货的商人勒索钱财以维持生计的手段。我鄙视他们，并未参与所谓的反奸活动。
1933年夏，由于生意萧条，我关闭了店铺，并与湖北学院的学生、我的朋友王宗明（Wang Tsung Ming，目前在汉口）一起，在奥古斯特·豪斯曼路（Rue Auguste Hauss）的北京火车站旅馆入住。我不记得房间号码。由于我

pages.en:
- 4 -
ill health, I rarely came out of the lodging house.
At the end of November, 1933, I received an express letter from my mother in Hankow to the effect that my father was very ill. I immediately left Shanghai for Hankow by a steamer (name forgotten) of the San Peh Steamship Company. My father died one day before I arrived at Hankow.
In January 1934, I came to Shanghai by a steamer (name not remembered) of the San Peh Steamship Company. On arriving here I, with the assistance of my friends, Zung Ming Yuen (陳明遠), and Li Ts Hung (李之鴻), established the "Hah Hui Watch & Clock Shop" (華美) at corner of Rue du Consulat and Rue Palikao and a branch shop at 1656 Bubbling Well Road. Zung Ming Yuen was formerly an editor of the Chung Hwa Book Company while Li Ts Hung (李之鴻) was a student of the Nanyang College. The latter is a native of Peiping and his family is quite wealthy. I don't know their present whereabouts. In evening I studied in the Liang Kai Supplementary School (量才), Continental Building, Nanking Road.
In October, 1934, I removed my shop from corner of Rue du Consulat and Rue Palikao to 257 Rue du Palikao.
Between January 1934 and August 1936 I, owing to ill-health, remained inactive.
In September, 1936, I together with Chiang Ching Zung (蔣經綜), ex-submanager of the Shing An Cigarette Factory on Rue Gaspard, and Chang Sing Jue (張靜波), a student, formed an "Ah Shing (one heart) League" (一心) with
pages.zh:
- 4 -
身体不好，我很少离开旅馆。
1933年11月底，我收到母亲从汉口寄来的快信，称父亲病重。我立即乘坐三北轮船公司的一艘轮船（船名忘记）离开上海前往汉口。在我抵达汉口前一天，父亲去世。
1934年1月，我乘坐三北轮船公司的一艘轮船（船名不记得）来到上海。抵达后，在朋友 Zung Ming Yuen（陳明遠）和李之鴻（Li Ts Hung）的帮助下，我在领事馆路（Rue du Consulat）与贝勒路（Rue Palikao）拐角处开设了“华美”钟表店，并在静安寺路1656号开设了一家分店。Zung Ming Yuen 曾是中华书局的编辑，而李之鴻（Li Ts Hung）是南洋大学的学生。后者是北平人，家境相当富裕。我不知道他们目前的下落。晚上，我在南京路大陆大楼的量才补习学校学习。
1934年10月，我将店铺从领事馆路与贝勒路拐角处迁至贝勒路257号。
1934年1月至1936年8月间，由于健康原因，我一直处于 inactive 状态。
1936年9月，我与加斯帕尔路（Rue Gaspard）新安烟厂的前副经理 Chiang Ching Zung（蔣經綜）以及学生 Chang Sing Jue（張靜波）一起，组建了一个“阿成（一心）联盟”（一心），

pages.en:
- 5 -
offices at No.18 Kung Yih Li (公益里), Zulum Road, Chapel,
with the object of promoting the political knowledge of the
people and uniting them in furthering national salvation
activities. The organisation had approximately 30 members
most of whom were labourers. They, however, did not carry
out any activities but were in October the same year (1936)
reorganized to be a section of the "Special Movement Corps"
formed under the auspices of the following persons:-
Wong Ping Nan (王彬南), a lawyer and ex-commander of
the Shanghai Citizens' Volunteer Corps.
Loh Ching Da (陸京士), Standing Committee member of
the Shanghai Kuomintang Headquarters.
Zoeng ( 曾 ) (name unknown), Chief of Staff of the
Shanghai-Woosung Garrison Commander's Headquarters.
This Corps had altogether 30 sections of from 30 to 40
members each and I was appointed in charge of the section
which was formed by the members of the "In Shing League."
The Headquarters of the Corps was established in the Coal
Merchants Guild opposite the "Small World Amusement Resort,"
City.
In January, 1937, some 150 members of the Corps were
given military training at a piece of vacant ground in Jao
Ba Zoong and at the same time they were given a series of
lectures on the political situation of the country. These
members, on completing the military training course, would
be assigned to enlist new members and organize them into
sub-sections. All the members of the Corps would be sent to
pages.zh:
- 5 -
办事处设在乍浦路公益里18号，旨在提高民众的政治知识，并团结他们推进救国活动。该组织约有30名成员，大多为工人。然而，他们并未开展任何活动，而是在同年（1936年）10月改组为在以下人士主持下成立的“特别运动队”的一个分队：
王彬南（Wong Ping Nan），律师，前上海市民义勇军指挥官。
陸京士（Loh Ching Da），国民党上海总部执行委员。
Zoeng ( 曾 )（姓名不详），上海吴淞警备司令部参谋长。
该队共有30个分队，每队30至40人，我被任命负责由“一心联盟”成员组成的分队。该队总部设在市内“小世界游乐场”对面的煤业公会。
1937年1月，约150名队员在闸北的一块空地上接受军事训练，同时听取了一系列关于国家政治局势的讲座。这些成员在完成军事训练课程后，将被指派招募新成员并将其组织成小组。所有队员将被派往

pages.en:
- 6 -

to Chapel and Hongkew and eastern areas of the Settlement,
and would be ordered to attack the Japanese from the rear
at the outbreak of the Sino-Japanese hostilities in Shanghai
which was then considered as inevitable.

Before the military training started members were told
by the promoters of the Corps that they would be supplied with
rifles, hand-grenades and other weapons but the promise was
not kept. The members gradually withdrew from participating
in the drill and until the beginning of February when the
training came to an end there were only 50 men present as
compared with 150 at the beginning of January. It was a
failure and this Corps was disbanded.

At the end of February or the beginning of March, 1937,
10 persons, including Loh Ching Da (陸京士), a member of
the Shanghai Kuomintang Headquarters, Wong Ping Han, a lawyer,
Woo Han Yung (吳學文), a journalist, Doo Zeu Yuen (杜月笙),
a journalist, Tsang Yuin (張雲), a student of the Chinan
University, and myself, organized a "Society to Promote the
the Offering of Iron and Steel to the Government" with offices
in the Coal Merchants Guild, then situated at Ningpo Road.
This Society, however, was not very active, but its formation
had the effect of prompting people of other localities to
form similar organizations.

Between March and June, 1937, I stayed at my shop
without undertaking any activities.

On July 7, 1937, the Chinese and Japanese forces clashed
at Lukouchiao. I, Zao Kang Yi (趙剛毅) and Liang Tung
pages.zh:
- 6 -

租界的闸北、虹口及东部地区，并奉命在中日战事于上海爆发时（当时认为不可避免）从后方袭击日本人。

在军事训练开始前，该队的发起者告诉成员们，他们将获得步枪、手榴弹和其他武器，但这一承诺并未兑现。成员们逐渐退出训练，直到2月初训练结束时，出席人数仅剩50人，而1月初时有150人。这是一次失败，该队随之解散。

1937年2月底或3月初，包括国民党上海总部委员陸京士（Loh Ching Da）、律师 Wong Ping Han、记者 Woo Han Yung（吳學文）、记者 Doo Zeu Yuen（杜月笙）、暨南大学学生 Tsang Yuin（張雲）和我在内的10人，组织了一个“劝募钢铁献政府协会”，办事处设在当时位于宁波路的煤业公会。然而，该协会并不活跃，但其成立确实促使其他地方的人们组建了类似的组织。

1937年3月至6月间，我待在店里，未从事任何活动。

1937年7月7日，中日军队在卢沟桥发生冲突。我、赵刚毅（Zao Kang Yi）和梁桐

pages.en:
- 7 -

Fang, decided to organize a "Chinese Youths' National
Salvation Association." I sold my two shops at Rue du
Weikwei and Bubbling Well Road respectively to one named
Yang Han Zung (楊漢宗), who was formerly my tutor for some
$1,000 and used same to finance the proposed association.

On July 8 or 9, 1937, we established a preparatory
office in the Tai Woo Bank Building, Nanking Road, but on
11/7/37, we removed to Kwan Ti Miao, Old West Gate, Nantao.
On July 15, 1937, the Chinese Youths National Salvation
Association was formally inaugurated at Kwan Ti Miao. It
had a total membership of some 1,000 persons consisting of
chiefly students and labourers who had come to the Associa-
tion in answering to advertisements published by the
organization in newspapers calling for members.

Hereunder is a list of the personnel of the organization:

Chief:                       Tao Kang Ti (趙剛毅)
Vice Chief:                  Liang Tung Jung (梁桐芳)
Execution Dept.              Sung Tsh Shing (孫史興)
  a) Military                Hsu Che Chi (徐國琦)
     Section:
  b) Special                 Sung Tsh Shing
     Service Section
     (additional tape
     section)
  c) Communication           None not remembered.
     Section

General Affairs              Liang Tung Jung
Department:

Training Dept.:              Wu Chen Chih (吳震之)
pages.zh:
- 7 -

方（Fang）决定组织一个“中国青年救国会”。我将分别位于魏格理路（Rue du Weikwei）和静安寺路（Bubbling Well Road）的两家店铺卖给了一位名叫杨汉宗（Yang Han Zung，楊漢宗）的人，他以前曾做过我的家庭教师，售价约为1,000元，我用这笔钱来资助拟议中的协会。

1937年7月8日或9日，我们在南京路的大华银行大楼设立了筹备处，但在1937年7月11日，我们迁至南市老西门的关帝庙。1937年7月15日，中国青年救国会在关帝庙正式成立。会员总数约1,000人，主要由学生和工人组成，他们是响应本会在报纸上刊登的招募会员广告而加入的。

以下是该组织的人员名单：

会长：                       赵刚毅（Tao Kang Ti，趙剛毅）
副会长：                     梁桐芳（Liang Tung Jung，梁桐芳）
执行部：                     孙史兴（Sung Tsh Shing，孫史興）
  a) 军事科：                徐国琦（Hsu Che Chi，徐國琦）
  b) 特务科                  孙史兴（Sung Tsh Shing）
     （另附录音科）
  c) 通讯科：                无人，不记得了。

总务部：                     梁桐芳（Liang Tung Jung）

训练部：                     吴震之（Wu Chen Chih，吳震之）

pages.en:
- 8 -

a) Organization
Section:
Ling Wei Liang (林惠亮)

b) Education Section:
Liang Wei Ling (梁惠林)

c) First-aid Section:
Sung Chia Yoong (孙家庸)

d) Propaganda Section:
Sung Chueh (孙觉)

The first 10 days following the inauguration of the Association
we were busy in forming the departments and sections and in
enlisting members.

On or about July 21, 1937, approximately 200 members of
the Association were despatched to Nanxiang to assist the
Chinese forces in that area under the command of Gen. Chang
Chi Chung to dig trenches and erect defense works. I was
appointed by the Association in charge of this Corps.
We carried out the aforementioned work in and around Nanxiang
for about one month (21/7/37 - 21/8/37). We were supplied
with food by the Army but received no pay. After the
outbreak of the Sino-Japanese hostilities in Shanghai (August
13, 1937) we used to do our work in the night owing to the
frequent bombing of the area by Japanese aeroplanes during the day.

The following persons who recently conducted assassination
and bomb-throwing in Shanghai under me also participated in the
erection of defense works on behalf of the Chinese Army:-

1. Tsou Ting alias Tsou Vee Yoong, who was connected with the
attempted murder of Tu Chuek Sung and sentenced to 2½
years imprisonment.

2. Wong Hung Sai (王光才), connected with the same attempt-
ed murder case, not in custody.
pages.zh:
- 8 -

a) 组织科：
林惠亮（Ling Wei Liang，林惠亮）

b) 教育科：
梁惠林（Liang Wei Ling，梁惠林）

c) 急救科：
孙家庸（Sung Chia Yoong，孙家庸）

d) 宣传科：
孙觉（Sung Chueh，孙觉）

在协会成立后的头10天里，我们忙于组建各部门及科室并招募会员。

1937年7月21日左右，协会约200名会员被派往南翔，协助张治中将军指挥下的该地区中国军队挖掘战壕和修筑防御工事。我被协会任命负责这支队伍。我们在南翔及其周边地区执行上述工作约一个月（1937年7月21日至1937年8月21日）。我们的食物由军队供应，但没有薪饷。在上海中日敌对行动爆发（1937年8月13日）后，由于日军飞机白天频繁轰炸该地区，我们通常在夜间工作。

以下人员近期在上海受我指挥进行暗杀和投掷炸弹活动，他们也曾代表中国军队参与修筑防御工事：

1. 邹定（Tsou Ting），又名邹维勇（Tsou Vee Yoong），与谋杀杜月笙未遂案有关，被判监禁2年半。

2. 王光才（Wong Hung Sai，王光才），与同一谋杀未遂案有关，未在押。

pages.en:
- 9 -

3. Kiang Kwei Sung (江桂生), alias Klang Hai Chu (江海秋),
who was arrested by the French Police on 7/7/38 for being
in possession of a bomb.
4. Tsau Sen Kong (周守刚), arrested at 62 Route Vallon on
22/7/38.
5. Wong Tse Kee (王子的), arrested on 23/7/38 at 62 Route
Vallon.
6. Ching Yoong Sung (金荣生), alias Doo Tse Mei (杜志梅),
not in custody.

While I was in Nanxiang in charge of the Corps in erecting
the defense works, other members of the Association were
engaged in conducting propaganda in Nantao as well as in
various other places along the S.N.R. and S.H.N.R. and in
organizing first aid corps to transport wounded soldiers from
the fronts to the hospitals in the foreign concessions.

On completing our work in Nanxiang I, together with my
comrades whose number had then been decreased from 200 to
150 (50 of them being suffering from sick) were transferred
to Lunghua and reorganized to be the 3rd Company, 7th Battalion
3rd Regiment of the Kiangsu-Chekiang Special Service Corps,
the Regiment in question being in charge of Chu Hsueh Fan
(朱学范), a prominent figure in the local labour circles
before the withdrawal of Chinese forces from Shanghai area.

At this time, Zao Kong Yi came to join us and he was
appointed commander of the 3rd Company, while I was in charge
of the 1st Section of the same unit. The Company was divided
into three sections of 45 men each.
pages.zh:
- 9 -

3. 江桂生（Kiang Kwei Sung，江桂生），又名江海秋（Klang Hai Chu，江海秋），于1938年7月7日因持有炸弹被法国警察逮捕。
4. 周守刚（Tsau Sen Kong，周守刚），于1938年7月22日在华伦路（Route Vallon）62号被捕。
5. 王子的（Wong Tse Kee，王子的），于1938年7月23日在华伦路（Route Vallon）62号被捕。
6. 金荣生（Ching Yoong Sung，金荣生），又名杜志梅（Doo Tse Mei，杜志梅），未在押。

当我在南翔负责队伍修筑防御工事时，协会的其他成员则在南市以及苏嘉铁路（S.N.R.）和沪杭铁路（S.H.N.R.）沿线的其他地方进行宣传，并组织急救队将前线伤员运送至外国租界的医院。

完成在南翔的工作后，我和同伴们（人数已从200人减少到150人，其中50人患病）被调往龙华，并重组为江浙特别服务队第三团第七营第三连，该团由朱学范（Chu Hsueh Fan，朱学范）负责，他是中国军队从上海地区撤退前当地劳工界的知名人物。

此时，赵公毅（Zao Kong Yi）加入我们要，并被任命为第三连连长，而我则负责该连第一排。该连分为三个排，每排45人。

pages.en:
- 10 -

In Lungiwa, the members of our company were militarily
trained, and were armed with rifles, pistols and hand-grenades.
By the end of September, 1937, we were transferred to the
Tung Yah Physical Culture School, Loo Pan Road, Nantao, and
assigned to garrison the area surrounding Pah Yung Kwan,
West Gate, where the "Martial Law Commander's Headquarters"
was located. At the same time we, members of the 3rd Company,
were empowered to take whatever effective measures we like
to suppress traitors.

Numerous persons, who had been arrested by us as well
as other police and military units at various districts in
Shanghai and its suburbs for perpetrating traitorous acts were
tried by a military court established in Pah Yung Kwan and
were executed when they were found guilty.

At the end of October, we were despatched to station
at Nantao Bund assisting the Police Reserve Unit in defending
the area from possible attack by the Japanese from the Whangpoo
Several attempts were made by the **〔此处转录不清〕** at the beginning
of November, 1937 to land troops at Nantao Bund by small
motor boats but were frustrated by the defense units.

When the Chinese troops fell back from Chapei to Pah
Sing Kying, the situation in Nantao became extremely tense
but we decided to fight to the bitter end.

In the night of November 11, 1937, the Police Reserve
Unit, who led us in defending Nantao, suddenly withdrew into
the French Concession thereby throwing the whole of Nantao into
a chaotic state. We exerted our best to stem the retreat
pages.zh:
- 10 -

在龙华，我们连的成员接受了军事训练，并配备了步枪、手枪和手榴弹。到1937年9月底，我们被调往南市鲁班路的东亚体育学校，并受命驻守西门八营关（Pah Yung Kwan）周边地区，那里是“戒严司令总部”所在地。同时，我们第三连的成员被授权采取任何有效措施来镇压汉奸。

许多因从事汉奸活动而被我们以及上海及其郊区各地区的其他警察和军事单位逮捕的人，由设在八营关的军事法庭审判，并在被判有罪后处决。

10月底，我们被派往驻守南市外滩，协助警察预备队防御来自黄浦江的日本人的可能攻击。1937年11月初，**〔此处转录不清〕**多次试图乘坐小型摩托艇在南市外滩登陆，但均被防御部队挫败。

当中国军队从闸北撤退到八字桥（Pah Sing Kying）时，南市的局势变得极其紧张，但我们决定战斗到底。

1937年11月11日晚，带领我们保卫南市的警察预备队突然撤入法租界，从而使整个南市陷入混乱状态。我们尽力阻止撤退
pages.guess: 本页有 1 处标注为影像不清。这类页面影像质量较差，**其余部分的转录可能包含较多推测**——模型会尽量读出残损处的文字，偶尔会猜错。引用前请对照左侧原件影像核对。

pages.en:
- 11 -

but without avail, and by 11 p.m. the same night we also
surrendered our arms to the French Military forces at
the Boundary and entered the French Concession through a
small iron gate at the south end of Boulevard de Montigny.
Zao Kong Yi, Wong Kuang Zai, Chiang Ching Zung,
Ping Foh Chong (平福昌), Li Tsung Hwei, myself, and
several others made good our escape from the custody of
the French Police on our way to the French Police Station.
I went to live in a room on the 7th floor of the
Yangtse Hotel, Yunnan Road, for four or five days and then
removed to the Woo Kung Hotel, corner of Foochow and Fukien
Roads where I stayed in a room on the 3rd floor for three
days. I do not remember the numbers of the rooms in these
two hotels where I had stayed.
When I left the Woo Kung Hotel, I engaged a small room
in the Si Zong Lodging House on Yu Ya Ching Road. At this
time, Chiang Ching Zung, Wong Kuan Zai, Ping Foh Chong,
and Li Tsung Hwei were living in a room in house 21 in an
alleyway (name not remembered) at the corner of Rue Ratard
and Rue Petiot. I do not know where Zao Kong Yi lived then
but he came to visit me at my lodging house at intervals.
In the meantime, I intended to continue to carry out
anti-traitor activities in Shanghai. When Ping Foh Chong,
one of the members of the 2nd Company, and a fairly well
known Chinese boxer in Shanghai, came to know my ambition,
he presented me with six books, and also purchased for me
3 machine gun mauser pistols at $40.00 each
pages.zh:
- 11 -

但无济于事，当晚11点，我们也向边界处的法国军队缴械，并通过蒙梯尼路（Boulevard de Montigny）南端的一个小铁门进入法租界。赵公毅（Zao Kong Yi）、王光哉（Wong Kuang Zai）、蒋敬宗（Chiang Ching Zung）、平福昌（Ping Foh Chong，平福昌）、李宗辉（Li Tsung Hwei）和我本人以及其他几人，在前往法国警察局的途中成功从法国警察的拘留中逃脱。
我去云南路的扬子饭店住在七楼的一个房间里，住了四五天，然后搬到了福州路和福建路角落的吴宫饭店，在三楼的一个房间里住了三天。我不记得我在这两家饭店住过的房间号码。
离开吴宫饭店后，我在虞洽卿路（Yu Ya Ching Road）的泗宗旅馆租了一个小房间。当时，蒋敬宗、王光哉、平福昌和李宗辉住在拉达路（Rue Ratard）和佩蒂奥路（Rue Petiot）拐角处一条弄堂（名字不记得了）21号的一个房间里。我不知道赵公毅当时住在哪里，但他间歇性地来我的住处看望我。
与此同时，我打算继续在上海进行反汉奸活动。当第二连的成员之一、也是上海相当有名的中国拳击手平福昌得知我的志向时，他送给我六本书，还以每支40.00元的价格为我购买了3支毛瑟冲锋手枪

pages.en:
- 12 -

1 revolver for $30.00
4 Browning automatic pistols at $30.00 each.

Ping told me that he had bought these from ex-members of
the 8th Battalion of the Kiangsu-Chekiang Special Service
Corps but I do not know them. Ping Poh Chong is at present
in Changsha, Hunan, serving in the Chinese Military.
When I obtained these firearms, I concealed all of them in
an attic in the Yah Mei Watch & Clock Shop on Rue du Walwei.

My plan to further the anti-traitor movement in Shanghai,
however, met with setbacks owing to lack of funds. In the
meantime, information was received to the effect that the
Japanese were endeavouring to arrest all the persons who
had participated in the Chinese Special Service Corps,
therefore, on December 16, 1937, Zao Kong Yi, Chiang Ching
Zung, Zee Hae Chi, Hsi Sz Cheng (倪士昌) and myself left
Shanghai by S.S. "Tah Ping" for Ningpo and thence by train
to Hangchow. Prior to my departure for Hangchow, I learned
that some 30 of my comrades who had been released from
internment by the French Police were accommodated in the
Sang Hong Refugee Camp on Alabaster Road.

On arriving at Hangchow, we were interviewed by Mr.
Huang Shao Hung (黄绍竑), Chairman of the Chekiang Pro-
vincial Government, who sent us to Shaoxing to assist Mr.
Ho Tung Ming (何东明), Inspector of the 3rd District of
Chekiang Province in the organisation of guerrilla units.
Mr. Ho, however, requested us to do the work in question but
appointed us to serve in the Shaoxing Hsien Government as
pages.zh:
- 12 -

1支左轮手枪，价格30.00元
4支勃朗宁自动手枪，每支30.00元。

平告诉我，他是从江浙特别服务队第八营的前成员那里买的，但我不认识这些人。平福昌（Ping Poh Chong）目前在湖南长沙服役于中国军队。
当我获得这些枪支后，我把它们全部藏在魏格理路（Rue du Walwei）亚美钟表店的一个阁楼里。

然而，由于缺乏资金，我在上海进一步推进反汉奸运动的计划遇到了挫折。与此同时，收到消息说日本人正努力逮捕所有参加过中国特别服务队的人，因此，1937年12月16日，赵公毅、蒋敬宗、谢海基（Zee Hae Chi）、倪士昌（Hsi Sz Cheng，倪士昌）和我本人乘“太平”轮（S.S. "Tah Ping"）离开上海前往宁波，然后乘火车去杭州。在前往杭州之前，我得知约有30名被法国警察解除拘禁的同伴被安置在阿尔巴斯特路（Alabaster Road）的三洪难民收容所。

抵达杭州后，我们受到了浙江省政府主席黄绍竑先生（Huang Shao Hung，黄绍竑）的接见，他将我们派往绍兴，协助浙江省第三区督察何东明先生（Ho Tung Ming，何东明）组织游击队。然而，何先生要求我们做这项工作，但任命我们在绍兴县政府任职

pages.en:
- 13 -
police officers.  Zao Kong Yi subsequently left for Hankow.
    Towards the end of January, 1938, I and Chiang Ching
Zung came to Shanghai via Ningpo with a view to bringing all
the ex-members of the 3rd Company of Special Service Corps,
who were in Shanghai, to Hankow to further national salvation
movement in the latter city.
    On arrival, Chiang and I proceeded to the Peking Lodging
House, Rue August Boppe and engaged a room on the ground
floor, number of the room not remembered.  The following day,
I went to the Zang Kong Lodging House, on Alabaster Road,
where I met:-
    Tseu Ying alias Tseu Vee Yoong,
    Ping Foh Chong,
    Wong Kwang Zai,
    Ching Yoong Sung alias Doo Tse Moi,
    Li Tsung Kwei,
    Kiong Kwei Sun; alias Kiong Hai Chin and
    Zao Liang (赵良), alias Zung Tu Zao (7东子赵),
and some thirty others.  They sang a song entitled "August
15" which they had composed themselves and I addressed them
in a brief speech stating that we were re-united and would
proceed to Hankow together to serve the country.
    However, on the following morning, I saw in the newspaper
a report reproduced from the "Shanghai Nichi Nichi" to the
effect that I, Sung Yah Shing, the leader of the Chinese
Youths National Salvation Association, an anti-Japanese
organisation, had arrived in Shanghai.  In order to avoid
possible danger, I did not proceed to the Zang Kong Lodging
pages.zh:
- 13 -
担任警官。随后赵公毅前往汉口。
    1938年1月底，我和蒋敬宗经宁波来到上海，目的是将所有在上海的特别服务队第三连前成员带到汉口，以在该市进一步推动救国运动。
    抵达后，蒋和我前往奥古斯特·博佩路（Rue August Boppe）的北京旅馆，在一楼租了一个房间，房间号码不记得了。第二天，我去了阿尔巴斯特路（Alabaster Road）的藏公旅馆，在那里我见到了：
    徐英（Tseu Ying），又名徐维勇（Tseu Vee Yoong），
    平福昌，
    王光哉，
    金荣生，又名杜志梅（Doo Tse Moi），
    李宗奎（Li Tsung Kwei），
    江桂孙（Kiong Kwei Sun），又名江海钦（Kiong Hai Chin），以及
    赵良（Zao Liang，赵良），又名钟土赵（Zung Tu Zao，7东子赵），
    以及其他约三十人。他们唱了一首自己创作的名为《八一五》的歌曲，我发表了简短讲话，表示我们重聚并将一同前往汉口为国效力。
    然而，第二天早上，我在报纸上看到一篇转载自《上海日日新闻》的报道，称我，宋雅兴（Sung Yah Shing），抗日组织中国青年救国会的领导人，已抵达上海。为了避免可能的危险，我没有再去藏公旅馆

pages.en:
- 14 -

Camp again, but sent Chiang Ching Zung, who had come to
Shanghai from Shaoshing together with me, to arrange for the
transportation of the members to Hankow. I also told Chiang
that I would proceed to Ningpo alone first and expect to
meet my comrades there.

I stayed in Shanghai for three days and left for Ningpo by
the s.s. "Tuh Ping."

I waited at Ningpo for about a week; my comrades had been
prevented from coming to that port in consequence of the
closing of the boom lying outside Ningpo by the Chinese
Military Authorities. Subsequently I left for Hankow,
arriving there in the middle of February, 1938. I met Zao
Kong Yi in Hankow, he had already had an office of the
"Chinese Youths National Salvation Association" established
in Hankow. My comrades later also arrived in the city,
they brought with them four new colleagues who are:-

Ngai Tseng Pang (颜振邦), not in custody.
Tai Ping Yuen (戴炳元), -do-
Tai Ts Yue (戴志法), deceased.
Tseu Tseng Ming (周振明), not in custody.

The Chinese Youths National Salvation Association had
altogether some 1,000 members in Hankow. It was organized
practically similar in the form as it was in Shanghai.
The Association was registered with the Chinese Authorities
in Hankow and received a monthly subsidy of approximately
$500.00 from the latter.

In April, 1938, the Association decided to despatch a
pages.zh:
- 14 -

营地，而是派与我一同从绍兴来到上海的蒋敬宗去安排成员前往汉口的运输事宜。我还告诉蒋，我将先独自前往宁波，并期望在那里与同伴们会合。

我在上海呆了三天，然后乘“太平”轮（s.s. "Tuh Ping"）前往宁波。

我在宁波等了大约一个星期；由于中国军事当局关闭了宁波外的拦河坝，我的同伴们无法来到该港口。随后我前往汉口，于1938年2月中旬抵达。我在汉口见到了赵公毅，他已经在汉口建立了“中国青年救国会”的办事处。我的同伴们后来也到达了该市，他们带来了四位新同事，分别是：

颜振邦（Ngai Tseng Pang，颜振邦），未在押。
戴炳元（Tai Ping Yuen，戴炳元），同上。
戴志法（Tai Ts Yue，戴志法），已故。
周振明（Tseu Tseng Ming，周振明），未在押。

中国青年救国会在汉口共有约1,000名会员。其组织形式实际上与在上海时相似。
该协会在汉口向中国当局注册，并从后者那里每月获得约500.00元的补贴。

1938年4月，协会决定派遣一支

pages.en:
- 15 -

a squad to Shanghai to suppress the traitors and I was
appointed in charge of the squad because I am well acquainted
with the conditions in Shanghai.

On or about April 25, 1938, I picked out the following
comrades and accompanied them to Shanghai:-

1st.
Weng Tse Koo ( 王 子 固 )
Tseu Vee Yoong ( 周 維 榮 )
Wong Kuan Zai ( 王 光 才 )

2nd.
Zao Seong Jao ( 趙 松 樵 )
Lau Zang Lih ( 呂 仁 烈 )
Tseu Tseng Ming ( 周 振 明 )

3rd.
Kiang Hwei Sung ( 江 桂 生 )
Zau Liang ( 趙 良 )
Tai Tse You ( 戴 志 祐 )

4th.
Chig Yong Sang cheo
Doo Tse Hai ( 杜 忠 梅 )
Sai Ping Yuen ( 戴 炳 元 )
Li Tseng Hwei ( 李 春 輝 )
Ngai Tseng Fung ( 顏 振 邦 )

We travelled to Shanghai, vid., Kukiang, Nanchang,
Kingkow, Tayeh, and Hangow. In Hangow I divided my comrades into
two groups:

Zao Seong Jao ( 趙 松  )
Lau Zang Lih ( 呂 仁 烈 )
Tseu Tseng Ming ( 周 振 明 )
pages.zh:
- 15 -

一支小队前往上海镇压汉奸，因我熟悉上海情况，被任命负责该小队。

1938年4月25日左右，我挑选了以下同志并陪同他们前往上海：

第一组：
Weng Tse Koo（王子固）
Tseu Vee Yoong（周维荣）
Wong Kuan Zai（王光才）

第二组：
Zao Seong Jao（赵松樵）
Lau Zang Lih（吕仁烈）
Tseu Tseng Ming（周振明）

第三组：
Kiang Hwei Sung（江桂生）
Zau Liang（赵良）
Tai Tse You（戴志祐）

第四组：
Chig Yong Sang cheo（原文不清）
Doo Tse Hai（杜忠梅）
Sai Ping Yuen（戴炳元）
Li Tseng Hwei（李春辉）
Ngai Tseng Fung（颜振邦）

我们经由九江、南昌、金口、大冶和汉口前往上海。在汉口，我将同志们分为两组：

Zao Seong Jao（赵松[樵]）
Lau Zang Lih（吕仁烈）
Tseu Tseng Ming（周振明）

pages.en:
- 16 -

Kiang Kwei Sung
Zao Liang alias Zung Tse Zao
Tai Tse Yue

2) Wong Tse Keo
Tseu Vee Yoong
Wong Kwan Sai
Ching Yoong Sung alias Doo Tse Mei
Tai Ping Yuen/Li Tsung Hwei
Ngan Tseng Paung (教振新) (Ngan immediately
absconded on arriving at Shanghai).

The first group left Ningpo on May 1, 1938, and the 2nd
group on May 2, 1938. I came to Shanghai together with
the second group by steamer (name not remembered) but in
different cabin so none of my comrades knows when I actually
arrived here.

In accordance with previous arrangements, I met Wong
Tse Keo of the 1st section in front of the Kuo Hwa Bank
on Bubbling Well Road near Avenue Haig, Zao Seong Jno of
the 2nd section in front of the Chinese Y.M.C.A., 123 Boulevard
de Montigny, Kiang Kwei Sung of the 3rd section outside the
Bubbling Well Branch of the Bank of China at Bubbling Well
Road and Yaten Road corner, Ching Yoong Sung alias Doo Tse
Mei in the Sek Da Lee Tea Shop near Rue Moustier on the
following 3 days after my arrival. The main object of
meeting them was to obtain their living places so that I
could contact them. I was then living in the room above
kitchen of Sing Ping Lodging House, Rue August Boppe.
pages.zh:
- 16 -

Kiang Kwei Sung（江桂生）
Zao Liang，又名 Zung Tse Zao（赵良，又名张子赵[音译]）
Tai Tse Yue（戴志祐[音译]）

第二组：
Wong Tse Keo（王子固[音译]）
Tseu Vee Yoong（周维荣）
Wong Kwan Sai（王光才[音译]）
Ching Yoong Sung，又名 Doo Tse Mei（程永松，又名杜忠梅[音译]）
Tai Ping Yuen / Li Tsung Hwei（戴炳元 / 李宗辉[音译]）
Ngan Tseng Paung（教振新）（Ngan抵达上海后立即潜逃）。

第一组于1938年5月1日离开宁波，第二组于1938年5月2日离开。我与第二组同乘一艘轮船（船名不记得）来到上海，但住在不同的舱室，因此我的同志都不知道我实际抵达的时间。

按照事先安排，我在抵达后的接下来三天内，分别会见了：在海格路（Avenue Haig）附近静安寺路的国华银行门前会见第一组的 Wong Tse Keo；在蒙梯尼路（Boulevard de Montigny）123号中华基督教青年会门前会见第二组的 Zao Seong Jno；在静安寺路与雅顿路（Yaten Road）转角处的中国银行静安寺分行门外会见第三组的 Kiang Kwei Sung；在穆斯捷路（Rue Moustier）附近的色达利茶室会见又名 Doo Tse Mei 的 Ching Yoong Sung。会见他们的主要目的是获取他们的住处，以便联络。当时我住在奥古斯特·博普路（Rue August Boppe）新平旅社厨房楼上的房间里。

pages.en:
- 17 -

On May 12, 1938, Zao Kong Yi arrived at Shanghai from
Hankow via Hongkong and by previous arrangements, we met in
front of the Dah Hwa Lodging House on Rue Auguste Boppe,
at 7 a.m. on May 13, 1938.

On or about May 20, 1938, I and Zao Kong Yi lived
together on the 1st floor of a foreign house at the corner
of Rue Lafayette and Avenue Dubail.

Under Zao Kong Yi were two squads namely the Execution
Squad and the Investigation Squad. I was in charge of the
Execution Squad which was responsible for the assassinations
and the throwing of bombs. I do not know who was in charge
of the Investigation Squad which was responsible for collect-
ing information regarding the activities of the traitors.
Zao Kong Yi examined all the information and if he decided
to kill certain traitor, he would pass the necessary inform-
ation regarding the movements and the description of the man
to me, and I would make arrangements to carry out the assassination

On about June 6, 1938, I received order from Zao to kill
Yiu Chush Sung who, according to information supplied me by
Zao, was a member of the Shanghai Citizens' Society and
would arrive at the Sassoon House on The Bund between 8 a.m.
9.30 a.m. daily by his motor car 5535 and leave there about
an hour later.

I decided to assign the 1st section to undertake this
mission, the 1st section then consisting of Kou Xing alias
Tseu Vee Yeong, Vong Kwan Zai and Tai Tze Yue. The three
were residing at Voisin Lodging House, Rue Voisin.
pages.zh:
- 17 -

1938年5月12日，Zao Kong Yi 经香港从汉口抵达上海，按照事先安排，我们于1938年5月13日上午7时在奥古斯特·博普路（Rue Auguste Boppe）大华旅社门前会面。

1938年5月20日左右，我和 Zao Kong Yi 共同居住在拉斐特路（Rue Lafayette）与杜拜尔路（Avenue Dubail）转角处的一栋西式房屋的一楼。

Zao Kong Yi 手下有两个小队，即行动队和调查队。我负责行动队，负责暗杀和投掷炸弹。我不知道谁负责调查队，该队负责收集关于汉奸活动的情报。Zao Kong Yi 审查所有情报，如果他决定杀死某个汉奸，他会将该人的行踪和体貌特征等必要情报交给我，由我安排执行暗杀。

1938年6月6日左右，我收到 Zao 的命令，要杀死 Yiu Chush Sung。据 Zao 提供给我的情报，此人是上海市民协会成员，每天上午8点至9点30分之间会乘坐他的5535号汽车到达外滩的沙逊大厦（Sassoon House），并在那里停留约一小时后离开。

我决定指派第一组执行此任务，当时第一组成员包括 Kou Xing，又名 Tseu Vee Yeong，Vong Kwan Zai 和 Tai Tze Yue。这三人居住在瓦赞路（Rue Voisin）的瓦赞旅社（Voisin Lodging House）。

pages.en:
- 18 -

At 7 a.m. on June 8, 1932, I carried one revolver and
one Browning auto pistol to the Voisin Lodging House by
thrusting them between my abdomen and the belt. I handed
the two pistols to Tseu Ying alias Tseu Vee Yoong and told
the three that they would be entrusted with a certain task.

The following day (June 9) I visited them again and
showed them a photograph of Yiu Chueh Sung. At the same
time I informed them the movements of Yiu and the number of
his motor car which is 8653. I gave them instructions that
Yiu should be fired upon from behind when he mounted his motor
car and that on accomplishing the mission, the two, who would
be assigned to do the shooting, should run east into Jinkee
Road or into the Sassoon Building to make good their escape.

In the afternoon of June 9, I met Tseu Ying, Tai Tee Yue
and Wong Huen Sui at the corner of Jinkee Road and The Bund
and there we made a general examination of the place. I left
them and returned to my home at corner of Avenue Edward VII and
Rue Lafayette.

In the same evening (June 9) I called on Tseu, Wong and
Tai at the Voisin Lodging House and instructed them to shoot
Yiu Chueh Sung on the morning of June 10, 1932. I told them
that if they succeeded in their mission and all managed to make
good their escape, they were to return to their lodging house.
But in case any of the three fell into the hands of the Police,
the remaining person or persons was forbidden to go back to
the place, instead, they should proceed between 6 and 7 p.m.
the same evening to the tram station outside the Palais Theatre
pages.zh:
- 18 -

1932年6月8日上午7时，我将一把左轮手枪和一把勃朗宁自动手枪塞在腹部与腰带之间，带到瓦赞旅社。我把这两把手枪交给 Tseu Ying，又名 Tseu Vee Yoong，并告诉这三人，他们将受委托执行一项特定任务。

第二天（6月9日），我再次拜访他们，并向他们展示了 Yiu Chueh Sung 的照片。同时，我告知他们 Yiu 的行踪及其汽车号码8653。我指示他们，当 Yiu 上车时，应从背后向其开枪；完成任务后，负责开枪的两人应向东跑入江西路（Jinkee Road）或进入沙逊大厦以逃脱。

6月9日下午，我在江西路与外滩的转角处会见了 Tseu Ying、Tai Tee Yue 和 Wong Huen Sui，我们在那里对现场进行了全面勘察。随后我离开他们，返回位于爱德华七世路（Avenue Edward VII）与拉斐特路转角处的住所。

当晚（6月9日），我去瓦赞旅社拜访 Tseu、Wong 和 Tai，指示他们在1932年6月10日上午枪杀 Yiu Chueh Sung。我告诉他们，如果任务成功且所有人都能顺利逃脱，就返回旅社。但如果三人中有任何人落入警方手中，其余人员禁止返回该处，而应在当天傍晚6点至7点之间前往派拉蒙大戏院（Palais Theatre）外的电车站。

pages.en:
- 19 -
on Avenue Joffre where a certain persons would meet them.
At about 8 a.m. June 10, 1936, I arrived at the scene
and later Tseu, Tai and Wong also turned up. I remained
in the vicinity of the spot until about noon when I heard
the report of pistol fire, I being then standing outside
the Palace Hotel, south east corner of the Bund and Nanking
Road. I immediately took a No.1 Route bus to corner of
Bubbling Well and Yu Ya Ching Road; and thence by ricksha
returned to my home at Avenue Dubail.
At 2 p.m. the same day I met Zao Seong Jae at corner of
Bubbling Well Road and Tifeng Road, he being posted on the
scene during the morning as an on-looker with the object of
obtaining information regarding the result of the shooting.
He told me that Tseu, while being chased by the police,
fell to the ground but he could not give me any information
in connection with Tai Sze Yue.
At about 6.30 p.m. on June 10, I dined with a female
friend of mine named Tsen Chuan (周 榛) in a Russian
restaurant on Avenue Joffre near Avenue Dubail. Later I
sent her to the Palais Theatre to see if any person was
waiting at the tram station there and if there was any to
see any suspicious character besides the person or persons.
She immediately returned and told me that there was one
there and no suspicious character could be found around him.
From the description she gave me regarding the man I under-
stood he was Wang Hua Shih. I left my girl friend and went
to meet Wang.
pages.zh:
- 19 -

在霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）上，会有特定人员与他们接头。1936年6月10日上午8点左右，我抵达现场，随后 Tseu、Tai 和 Wong 也出现了。我一直留在该区域附近，直到中午时分听到枪声，当时我正站在外滩与南京路东南角的华懋饭店（Palace Hotel）外。我立即乘坐1路公交车到静安寺路与虞洽卿路（Yu Ya Ching Road）的转角处，然后乘黄包车返回杜拜尔路的住所。

当天下午2点，我在静安寺路与提篮桥路（Tifeng Road）转角处会见了 Zao Seong Jae，他上午作为旁观者被部署在现场，目的是获取枪击结果的情报。他告诉我，Tseu 在被警察追捕时摔倒在地，但他无法向我提供关于 Tai Sze Yue 的任何信息。

6月10日晚上6点30分左右，我与一位名叫 Tsen Chuan（周榛）的女性朋友在霞飞路靠近杜拜尔路的一家俄罗斯餐馆用餐。后来，我派她去派拉蒙大戏院，看看电车站是否有人在等候，以及除了接头人之外是否有其他可疑人物。她立即回来告诉我，那里有一个人，且在他周围没有发现可疑人物。根据她对该男子的描述，我得知他是 Wang Hua Shih。我离开女友去见 Wang。

pages.en:
- 20 -

He could not tell me anything about Tseu Ying nor
Tai Tse Yue but I had read the evening newspaper of that
day and I knew that Tai was shot dead while Tseu arrested
by the Police. He, Wang Kwan Zni, told me that he would
live with his cousin a few days. I permitted him to do so
but instructed him to meet me at 7 a.m. on June 13, at the
corner of Avenue Dubail and Rue Lafayette. On that day I
brought him to the Dah Zung Lodging House, Rue Auguste
Deppe where he together with Ching Yoong Sung, Li Tsung
Hwei lived in Room 51.

Prior to the attempted murder of Yiu Chuen Sung,
I assigned the 3rd section consisting of Kiang Kwei Sung,
Zao Liang, alias 张啸林 Zung Tse Zao and Tai Tse Yue, to check the
movements of Chang Shiao Ling, who, according to information
supplied to me by Zao Kong Yi, was a traitor. The three
went to live in an attic above the Zung An Li (仁安里)
Alleyway, Rue Wagner, opposite to which is the residence of
Chang Shiao Ling. They were not successful in their work.
They failed to preserve the secrecy of their work with the
result that 陈元良 Sung 陈周龙 Kung alias 冯 Zung Hsi Kung and 闵元
Zni Yuan, the two sons of the private watchmen of the
alleyway became aware of their mission. Without hesitation
I ordered them to remove away from the alleyway and trans-
ferred Tai Tse Yue to Tsen Voo Yeong's section.

On or about June 19, Mr. Kong Yi passed the information
to me that Inspector Wu Ping Shi (伍平士), alias Woo Sung Yu
(伍成宇), with offices in the Dai Voo Building, Nanki Road,
pages.zh:
- 20 -

他无法告诉我关于 Tseu Ying 或 Tai Tse Yue 的任何消息，但我读了当天的晚报，知道 Tai 被击毙，而 Tseu 被警方逮捕。他，Wang Kwan Zni，告诉我他将与表亲同住几天。我允许他这样做，但指示他在6月13日上午7时在杜拜尔路与拉斐特路转角处与我见面。那天，我带他到奥古斯特·德普路（Rue Auguste Deppe）的大众旅社（Dah Zung Lodging House），他与 Ching Yoong Sung、Li Tsung Hwei 一起住在51号房间。

在企图谋杀 Yiu Chuen Sung 之前，我指派由 Kiang Kwei Sung、Zao Liang（又名张啸林 Zung Tse Zao）和 Tai Tse Yue 组成的第三组，去监视汉奸 Chang Shiao Ling 的行踪，这是根据 Zao Kong Yi 提供给我的情报。这三人住进瓦格纳路（Rue Wagner）仁安里（Zung An Li）弄堂上方的阁楼里，对面就是 Chang Shiao Ling 的住所。他们的工作没有成功。他们未能保守工作秘密，导致弄堂私人巡捕的两个儿子，陈元良 Sung 陈周龙 Kung（又名冯 Zung Hsi Kung）和闵元 Zni Yuan，察觉了他们的任务。我毫不犹豫地命令他们撤离弄堂，并将 Tai Tse Yue 调至 Tsen Voo Yeong 的小组。

1938年6月19日左右，Kong Yi 先生向我传递情报称，在南京路大无大楼（Dai Voo Building）设有办公室的督察 Wu Ping Shi（伍平士），又名 Woo Sung Yu（伍成宇），

pages.en:
- 22 -

was a traitor. I assigned Zao Soong Jao, Lu Zung Lih
and Tseu Tseng Ming, members of the 2nd section to make
the necessary enquiries regarding the movement of lawyer
Woo, they being then living at the Sing Ping Lodging House,
Rue Auguste Boppe.

On or about June 21, 1938, when I visited them at their
lodging house, they told me that they had made the necessary
enquiries and were capable to execute the mission. I
instructed Zao Soong Jao to tie a white handkerchief on his
wrist and to proceed to the corner of Rue du Consulat and
Boulevard de Montigny in the evening when some person would
hand him the weapons for committing the crime.

I arranged for Tseu Chuan to take out two mauser pistols
from the Yah Mei Watch & Clock Shop on Rue du Weikwei and
have same handed over to Zao Soong Jao at corner of Rue
du Consulat and Boulevard de Montigny. The firearms were
placed in a cardboard box for holding stocking when they
were handed over by Tseu Chuan to Zao Soong Jao. Tseu
Chuan has left for Hankow recently.

The following day, June 22, I called upon them again
and instructed them to have the work executed within three
days. They told me that they would probably do it on June
24.

In the evening of June 24, I called at their room in
the lodging house. Before entering, I saw the window of
the room was open and on it was hung a towel, which was
was a sign showing that they were in the room.
pages.zh:
- 22 -

是一名汉奸。我指派第二组成员 Zao Soong Jao、Lu Zung Lih 和 Tseu Tseng Ming 对律师 Woo 的行踪进行必要调查，当时他们住在奥古斯特·博普路（Rue Auguste Boppe）的新平旅社（Sing Ping Lodging House）。

1938年6月21日左右，当我到他们的旅社拜访时，他们告诉我已经完成了必要调查，并有能力执行任务。我指示 Zao Soong Jao 在手腕上系一条白手帕，并于晚上前往领事馆路（Rue du Consulat）与蒙梯尼路（Boulevard de Montigny）的转角处，届时会有人将作案武器交给他。

我安排 Tseu Chuan 从魏克威路（Rue du Weikwei）的亚美钟表店取出两支毛瑟手枪，并在领事馆路与蒙梯尼路转角处交给 Zao Soong Jao。Tseu Chuan 将枪支放在一个装袜子的纸盒里交给了 Zao Soong Jao。Tseu Chuan 最近已前往汉口。

第二天，6月22日，我再次拜访他们，指示他们在三天内执行任务。他们表示可能会在6月24日动手。

6月24日晚上，我到他们在旅社的房间拜访。进门前，我看到房间的窗户开着，上面挂着一条毛巾，这是表示他们在房间内的信号。

pages.en:
- 22 -

I learned from them that they had shot a wrong man on
that afternoon in the Tai Woo Building, Lloyd Road, and they
had discarded their two pistols. I warned them to be more careful
afterwards and subsequently took my departure.

The following day, I sent the three away to Hankow via
Ningpo to undergo some adequate punishment there. Their
mistake, I deemed, is unpardonable. Firstly they shot a
wrong man and secondly they discarded their pistols without
any threat of danger for carrying away arms with them.

At the end of June, Zao Kong Yi instructed me to arrange
for some demonstration on July 7, 1938, the "1st Anniversary
of the Lushun Incident," we being both residing at Lane
839, House 14 Avenue Joffre. I then assigned Wong Chien
Hing (王健兴), an errand boy of Zao Kong Yi, to have the
six bombs kept by me at the Ya Mei Watch & Clock Shop, Rue
du Milieu, removed to the Dah Kun Lodging House, Rue Auguste
Bard, where Wong Tse Kee and Kiang Kwai Sung were residing.
At the same time I also received two bombs from Zao Kong Yi
and these two bombs were also sent to Dah Kun Lodging House
by Wong Chien Hing. I ordered all the members to investigate
as to which places the bombs were to be thrown.

After considering the reports I later collected from
the members, I decided to have the bombs thrown from the
following localities into Japanese occupies areas:-

The Bund
Nanking Road
Bubbling Well Road
pages.zh:
- 22 -

我从他们那里得知，当天下午他们在劳合路（Lloyd Road）的大无大楼（Tai Woo Building）误杀了一人，并且丢弃了两把手枪。我警告他们以后要更加小心，随后离开。

第二天，我将这三人经宁波送往汉口，在那里接受适当的惩罚。我认为他们的错误是不可原谅的。首先，他们杀错了人；其次，他们在没有携带武器面临危险威胁的情况下丢弃了手枪。

6月底，Zao Kong Yi 指示我安排1938年7月7日“卢沟桥事变一周年”的示威活动，当时我们都住在霞飞路839弄14号。于是我指派 Zao Kong Yi 的勤务员 Wong Chien Hing（王健兴），将我存放在中路（Rue du Milieu）亚美钟表店的六枚炸弹转移到奥古斯特·巴德路（Rue Auguste Bard）的大坤旅社（Dah Kun Lodging House），Wong Tse Kee 和 Kiang Kwai Sung 住在那里。同时，我还从 Zao Kong Yi 那里接收了两枚炸弹，这两枚炸弹也由 Wong Chien Hing 送到大坤旅社。我命令所有成员调查应将炸弹投掷到哪些地点。

在考虑了我后来从成员那里收集的报告后，我决定从以下地点向日本占领区投掷炸弹：

外滩
南京路
静安寺路

pages.en:
- 23 -

On July 5 or 6 ( I don't remember the exact date ),
Li Chi Voe ( 李之何 ) , a member of the Investigation Squad
under Zao Kong Yi approached me for two bombs for his use
on July 7. With the approval of Zao Kong Yi, I sent Tseu
Seu Kong to take the two bombs, which I received from Zao,
from the Dah Hwa Lodging House and hand same to Li. I do
not know where these two bombs were thrown. Tseu Seu Kong
was formerly a member of the Chinese Youths National Salvation
Association, but did not accompany me to Hankow. On about
June 20 I met him in Rue du Marche. He is a faithful youth
and I appointed him to be the liaison officer between me and
my comrades. He subsequently removed to live together with
me at 3 Ching Yuen Li, Sinza Road. On or about July 1, I
removed to Lane 833, House 14, Avenue Joffre, while Tseu
removed to 62 Route Vallon.

In the meantime, Zung Kai Kwang and Zung Kai Yuen,
the two sons of Zung Ah Nyi ( 张阿尼 ) , the private watchman
of Sung An Li, Rue Wagner, applied to my squad for membership
through Wong Tse Kee. After some consideration I decided to
let them have a trial.

On July 6, I gave instructions through Tseu Seu Kong
that Li Tsung Hwei took two pistols (one Mauser and one
Browning auto pistol) from the Yah Mei Watch & Clock Shop and
that the members be assigned with the following tasks on
July 7:-

Wong Hsue Hai to throw a bomb from Alabaster Rd. into Chung.Sl.
Sung Kai Tsun - 4a -
pages.zh:
- 23 -

7月5日或6日（我不记得确切日期），赵恭义（Zao Kong Yi）手下调查队队员李之何（Li Chi Voe）向我索取两枚炸弹，供其于7月7日使用。经赵恭义批准，我派徐世康（Tseu Seu Kong）从大华旅馆取走我从赵处收到的两枚炸弹，并交给李。我不知道这两枚炸弹被投掷于何处。徐世康曾是中国青年救国协会成员，但未随我前往汉口。约在6月20日，我在马尔斯路（Rue du Marche）遇见了他。他是一名忠诚的青年，我任命他为我和同志之间的联络员。随后他搬来与我同住于新闸路景远里3号。约在7月1日，我搬至霞飞路833弄14号，而徐则搬至瓦隆路（Route Vallon）62号。

在此期间，华格纳路（Rue Wagner）宋安里私人巡捕张阿尼（Zung Ah Nyi）的两个儿子张凯光（Zung Kai Kwang）和张凯元（Zung Kai Yuen），通过黄子基（Wong Tse Kee）向我的小队申请加入。经过一番考虑，我决定让他们试用。

7月6日，我通过徐世康下达指令，让李宗辉（Li Tsung Hwei）从亚美钟表店取出两支手枪（一支毛瑟枪和一支勃朗宁自动手枪），并指派各成员于7月7日执行以下任务：-

王学海（Wong Hsue Hai）从阿尔巴斯特路（Alabaster Rd.）向中滑（Chung.Sl.，原文不清，疑为地名缩写）投掷炸弹。
宋凯尊（Sung Kai Tsun） - 4a -

pages.en:
- 24 -

Li Tsung Hwei to throw a bomb from Kansu Road and
Haining Road corner into Chapel.

Zao Liang alias Zung Ta Zao to protect Li Tsung Hwei
with a mauser pistol. In case any Japanese soldiers
gave chase after the bomb was thrown by Li, Zao would
shoot the Japanese soldiers.

Weng Tse Kee to throw a bomb at the Floating Restaurant
from The Bund.

Zung Kai Kwang to throw a bomb at the Yokohama Specie
Bank, The Bund.

Kiang Kwei Sung to throw a bomb into Nantao from
the French Bund.

Ching Yeong Sung to protect Kiang Kwei Sung with a
Browning pistol.

They were instructed to carry out the task in the early
morning of July 7 and to report the result to Tsen Seu Kong
at the Zah Zah Zah Yi Lou Tea Shop (口口得意楼),
at Dah Sian Joo Market, French Concession, the latter being
posted for duty there on that morning. They were also ordered
to change their addresses on that date, Weng Huen Sai, Ching
Yeong Sung and Li Tsung Hwei, then residing in Room 31, Dah
Seng Lodging House, Rue Auguste Bague; Kiang Kwei Sung, Weng
Tse Kee and Zao Liang, in Room 47 Dah Hwa Lodging House,
Rue Auguste Bague; and Zung Kai Kwang and Zung Kai Tsen at
their home in Sang An Li, Rue Wagner.

At about 6 a.m. on July 7, I went to the Zah Zah Zah
Yi Lou Tea Shop and there I saw all the members of my squad
pages.zh:
- 24 -

李宗辉从甘肃路与海宁路拐角处向教堂（Chapel）投掷炸弹。

赵良（Zao Liang），别名张大赵（Zung Ta Zao），持毛瑟手枪保护李宗辉。如果李宗辉投掷炸弹后有日本士兵追赶，赵将射击日本士兵。

翁子基（Weng Tse Kee）从外滩向浮水餐厅（Floating Restaurant）投掷炸弹。

张凯光向外滩横滨正金银行（Yokohama Specie Bank）投掷炸弹。

江贵松（Kiang Kwei Sung）从法外滩向南市投掷炸弹。

金荣生（Ching Yeong Sung）持勃朗宁手枪保护江贵松。

他们受令于7月7日凌晨执行任务，并将结果报告给在法租界大仙酒市场“口口得意楼”茶馆（Zah Zah Zah Yi Lou Tea Shop）值勤的徐世康。他们还受令于当日更改住址，当时翁惠赛（Weng Huen Sai）、金荣生和李宗辉住在奥古斯特·巴盖路（Rue Auguste Bague）大盛旅馆31室；江贵松、翁子基和赵良住在奥古斯特·巴盖路大华旅馆47室；张凯光和张凯珍（Zung Kai Tsen）住在华格纳路宋安里的家中。

7月7日上午6点左右，我前往“口口得意楼”茶馆，在那里我看到了我小队的所有成员

pages.en:
- 25 -
except Kiang Kwei Sung, scattering in various parts of the
tea shop. I heard the report from Tseu Seu Kwang to the
effect that Kiang had been arrested by the French Police.
The members then took their departure separately, they had
informed Tseu of their new addresses. The two pistols
carried by Li Tsung Hwei and Ching Yoong Sung were returned
to the Yah Mei Watch & Clock Shop on the same morning.
On July 17, 1938, Zao Kong Yi informed me that Zung
Yush Poo (许月波) was a traitor and supplied me a detailed
description of the man and information regarding his daily
movements. I, in turn, passed the information to Tseu Seu
Kong and instructed him to direct Zung Kai Kwang and Zung
Kai Yuen to conduct the assassination.
The two made some enquiries in the vicinity of Jessfield
Road on the following two days with a view to identifying the
man.
On the morning of July 21, I assigned Tsu Zeong Foo
(朱仲克), who had joined our squad in the middle of June,
1938, to have two pistols removed from the Yah Mei Clock
Shop and handed over to Zung Kai Kwang. Whenever I wanted
to have firearms removed from the Yah Mei Clock Shop, I
used to visit the shop beforehand wrapped them with newspaper
or placed them in cardboard boxes so that the members would
have no trouble in obtaining same from the place. Kiang
(江), a boy of the clock shop, was often asked by me to
hand the parcels to the members who applied there for same.
Zung Kai Kwang and Zung Kai Yuen were ordered to carry
pages.zh:
- 25 -
除了江贵松，他们分散在茶馆的各个角落。我听徐世康（此处原文为Tseu Seu Kwang，与前文Tseu Seu Kong应为同一人）报告说，江已被法国警察逮捕。随后成员们各自离开，他们已将自己的新地址告知了徐。李宗辉和金荣生携带的两支手枪于当天上午归还至亚美钟表店。
1938年7月17日，赵恭义通知我，许月波（Zung Yush Poo）是叛徒，并向我提供了该人的详细体貌特征及其日常活动信息。我随即将这些信息转告徐世康，并指示他指挥张凯光和张凯元实施刺杀。
两人在接下来的两天里在极司菲尔路（Jessfield Road）附近进行了一些打听，以便确认此人身份。
7月21日上午，我指派朱仲克（Tsu Zeong Foo，音译，括号内中文为译者注，原文拼音对应朱仲克或类似发音），他于1938年6月中旬加入我们小队，从亚美钟表店取出两支手枪并交给张凯光。每当我需要从亚美钟表店取出枪支时，我都会事先去店里，用报纸包裹或放入纸板箱中，以便成员们能顺利从那里取走。钟表店的一个男孩江（Kiang，音译）经常被我要求将包裹交给前来领取的成员。张凯光和张凯元受令执行

pages.en:
- 26 -
out the mission on the early morning of July 22, 1938.
At about 10.30 a.m. July 22, 1938, Tseu Sou Kong came
to my home reporting that Zung Kai Yuen had returned from
the scene of shooting occurred on that morning but Zung Kai
Kwang's fate was not known, the latter was being chased by
a foreign policeman when Zung Kai Yuen left the scene.
At 7 p.m. July 22, Tseu Sou Kong came to my home and
reported that the home of Zung Kai Kwang at 276 Rue Eugene
Bard had been raided by the Police and the living place of
Ching Yoong Sung, Heng Kwan Zai and Li Tsung Hwei at No.2,
Lane 241 Rue des Soeurs, were kept under observation by the
police too. I instructed him to remove all his property
to my home immediately and live together with me at Lane 833,
House 14, Avenue Joffre.
At about 11 p.m. July 22, while I was awaiting the
arrival of Tseu, the latter, not alone, but accompanied with
a police party, entered my room and I was arrested.
Half an hour later, I led the police to the Yah Mei
Clock Shop where on information supplied by me, they seized
the two pistols, one mauser and the other an auto pistol,in
the attic of the shop.
At the time of my arrest Heng Kong Yi, who was also
living at 833, House 14, Avenue Joffre, together with me,
was absent from home. He was expected to return the same
evening.
The expenses incurred by my squad were given by Zao
Heng Yi, they being approximately $300.00 per month.
pages.zh:
- 26 -
1938年7月22日凌晨的任务。
1938年7月22日上午10点30分左右，徐世康（此处原文为Tseu Sou Kong）来到我家报告说，张凯元已从当天早晨发生的枪击现场返回，但张凯光的下落不明，张凯元离开现场时，后者正被一名外籍警察追捕。
7月22日晚上7点，徐世康来到我家报告说，警察搜查了张凯光位于尤金·巴德路（Rue Eugene Bard）276号的住所，并且警察也在监视金荣生、恒关仔（Heng Kwan Zai，音译）和李宗辉位于姐妹路（Rue des Soeurs）241弄2号的住处。我指示他立即将所有财物搬到我这里，并与我同住在霞飞路833弄14号。
7月22日晚上11点左右，当我等待徐到来时，后者并非独自前来，而是陪同着一队警察进入我的房间，我被捕了。
半小时后，我带领警察前往亚美钟表店，根据我提供的信息，他们在该店的阁楼里查获了两支手枪，一支是毛瑟枪，另一支是自动手枪。
在我被捕时，同样与我住在霞飞路833弄14号的恒恭义（Heng Kong Yi，音译）不在家。预计他将于当晚返回。
我小队的开支由赵恒义（Zao Heng Yi，音译）提供，每月大约300.00美元。

pages.en:
- 27 -

The members of my squad received no wages but were supplied
with food and lodging.

From the fact that there were a number of anti-traitor
assassinations other than those committed by the squad under
my control, I conclude that there must exist in Shanghai more
than one assassination groups working on a line similar to
that adopted by my squad. I do not know them because we have
been working independently from each other.
pages.zh:
- 27 -

我小队的成员没有工资，但提供食宿。

鉴于除了我所控制的小队实施的刺杀外，还有多起反叛徒刺杀事件，我推断上海必定存在不止一个采用与我小队类似方式行动的刺杀团体。我不了解他们，因为我们一直彼此独立行动。

pages.en:
Form 40
G. 5000 2-29

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
========================
REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.
================================

The following is the statement of Zung Kwei Keng
native of Shanghai taken by me D.S.I. Crighton
at 6.30 p.m. on the 28-7-38 and interpreted by D.S. Bang

My name is Zung Kwei Keng (张桂庚) alias Zung Hyeoh Liang (张惠良), age 18, native of Zaechow, Kwantung Province.
I was born in Shanghai in May 1921. My parents at this time were residing in the Zung An Li (众安里), Rue Wagner, French Concession, where my father was engaged as a watchman (private). Since this time my parents have resided at this address following the same occupation.
At the age of 8 years I went to study at the Sung Wu ( ) Primary School, located on Rue Petiot, French Concession, and remained therein until at the age of 11 years when I went to the Ung Wei ( ) Primary School on Rue Brenier de Montmorand, where I remained for 6 years.
I then attempted to get employment but was unsuccessful, and just around this time the Sino-Japanese hostilities broke out. During my time at school I never studied nor was I ever taught any political doctrines. Between the outbreak of hostilities and July 1, 1938, I did practically nothing, and usually spent my time watching the fighting between the Japanese and Chinese. On the latter date I was approached by an old friend named Zan Liang (赵良) who at one time lived in the same alleyway as I was then residing and requested me to join the Chinese Youths National Salvation Association. As my feelings were then towards my country, I readily agreed to join in and at the same time expressed my willingness to help in the extermination of traitors. On my expressing my feelings thus, Zan Liang (赵良) then

我叫张桂庚（Zung Kwei Keng），别名张惠良（Zung Hyeoh Liang），18岁，广东省潮州人。
我于1921年5月出生在上海。当时我的父母居住在法租界华格纳路众安里（Zung An Li），父亲担任私人巡捕。自那时起，我的父母一直居住在该地址，从事同样的职业。
8岁时，我就读于法租界佩蒂奥特路（Rue Petiot）的崇武（Sung Wu，音译）小学，直到11岁转入布伦尼尔·德·蒙特莫兰路（Rue Brenier de Montmorand）的英伟（Ung Wei，音译）小学，在那里读了6年。
随后我试图找工作，但未成功，就在此时，中日敌对行动爆发。在校期间，我从未学习也未被教授任何政治学说。从敌对行动爆发到1938年7月1日，我几乎无所事事，通常花时间观看日军与华军的战斗。在后一日期，一位名叫赵良（Zan Liang，音译，前文作Zou Liang/Zao Liang）的老朋友接触了我，他曾与我住在同一条弄堂，他请求我加入中国青年救国协会。鉴于我当时爱国的情感，我欣然同意加入，同时表示愿意协助铲除汉奸。当我如此表达我的心意时，赵良（Zan Liang）便

of a mound located in the south west corner of the Kou-Ka-Za
Park French Concession when he would give me his final

At 7 p.m. on the 6th. July 1938, I in company of
Wang's son (王子固) whom I had also previously known, proceeded
to the Kou-Ka-Za Park, and in the place mentioned I met
Zou Liang (赵良) who then introduced me to his Chief Sung Yah
Sing ( ). After he had introduced us, he left us together,
and once alone, Sung Yah Sing ( ) asked me whether or not
I could throw a bomb properly. I told him I could not but was
willing to learn. He then carefully explained how I must undo
the screw cap, put my small finger into the loop of a piece of
string that would be disclosed after I had removed the cap, then
holding this tightly with my small finger I would throw the bomb,
which would leave the piece of string around my finger, after
which I was to retreat a few feet to be out of range of the
explosion. I listened carefully and finally agreed that I could
accomplish this job. He then instructed me that he would later
send a bomb to my home and that it would be my duty to take same
the following morning to the corner of Sincere and Ah-burn roads,
where I would no doubt encounter a few Japanese civilians at
whom I was to throw same. The same hour he further explained

Between this time and the 11th. July 1935, nothing of

enquiries as to whether or not this man was a traitor and if I
was convinced that he was I was then to study his daily
movements with a view to assassinating him. At about 4.40 p.m.
that afternoon I proceeded to the Hardoon Building on Nanking
Road near Henan Road, and waited outside until 6 p.m., but
failed to see this man. I then returned to 276 Rue Eugene Bard.

brother Zung Kui Hyeu (张润元) proceeded to Jessifield Road
near Tifeng Road, where we waited. At about 9 a.m. we saw the
described man Jung Kyoh Poo ( ) coming towards down

native of Shanghai taken by me D.S.I. Orlighton
at 6.30 P.M. on the 28-7-38 and interpreted by D.S. Dang

met with the same success. However on the morning of 22-7-38
at about 9.15 a.m. we saw our intended victim come from the
alleyway. At this time I was standing on Jessfield Road
just opposite Avenue Road whilst my brother was on the
opposite side of the roadway. I allowed Fung Mych Foo
( ) to pass me then I followed close on his heels for
about 5 or 6 yards then seeing my opportunity I took my pistol
out and shot him twice in the back, after which I turned
round and ran towards Tifeng Road. At this time I noticed
I was being chased by a foreign police officer on horseback
and when about half way down Tifeng Road near to a garage
I turned and fired several shots at him. The foreigner
returned the fire and I kept running. At this time my
pistol jammed and I threw same away and stopped running.
The foreigner who by this time had dismounted from his horse
then effected my arrest and took me to Bubbling Well Station.
I have never participated in any other case and this
is my true statement.
pages.zh:
表格 40
G. 10,000-1-31

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
===
警务调查报告。
===

以下系本人 D.S.I. Orlighton 于 1938 年 7 月 28 日下午 6 时 30 分对上海籍人士 Zung Kwei Keng（音译）所作的供词记录，由 D.S. Dang 担任翻译

取得了同样的结果（指未成功）。然而在 1938 年 7 月 22 日上午
约 9 时 15 分，我们看见预定的目标从弄堂里出来。
当时我正站在极司菲尔路上，正对着爱文义路（Avenue Road），而我的兄弟则在马路
对面。我让 Fung Mych Foo ( ) 从我身边经过，然后紧紧跟在他身后
约 5 或 6 码，见机行事，我掏出手枪，
朝他的背部开了两枪，随后转身
向提丰路跑去。此时我注意到
一名外籍巡捕骑马在追赶我，当跑到提丰路中段靠近一家汽车行时，
我转身向他开了几枪。那名外国人
还击，我继续奔跑。此时我的
手枪卡壳，我便将其扔掉并停止奔跑。
那名外国人此时已下马，
随即将我逮捕，并带我到静安寺捕房。
我从未参与过其他案件，
这是我的真实供词。

pages.en:
Zeu Liang ( 趙良 ) alias Zung Ts Zau(陳子超)
Hangchow                                      D.S. Bradley
                                              C.D.C.273

My name is Zeu Lisng (趙良) alias Zung Ts Zau(陳子超),
aged 38, soldier, native of Hangchow, residing in 278 We Fung
Fong off Rue Eugene Bard, Frenchtown.

Prior to the present hostilities I was a cardboard box
maker for 12 years at the Siau Toong Ming, Nantao.

On the outbreak of hostilities I joined a branch of the
plain clothes army that operated behind the Chinese lines and
I saw service fighting against the Japanese until the occupa-
tion of Nantao by the Japanese Forces.

I with many others succeeded in escaping from Nantao
to the French Concession where we were interned by the French
Authorities in the Shanghai Law School, Rue Pere Robert. After
being interned there for 57 days we were released and I with
a number of others proceeded to the Tsang Kong Refugee Camp,
Alabaster Road, where we resided for about one month. At
the end of the month, Zung Yah Shing who had served with me
as a plain clothes soldier came to the refugee camp and told
a number of us that we would be more useful to our Country
in Hankow and he wished that a number of us should be willing
to proceed there and if we agreed he would provide the means
of transportation for us. 45 of the refugees in the camp
including myself agreed to take advantage of Zung Yah Shing's
offer and on 23/3/38, we left Shanghai on a British Steamer
for Hongkong. We stayed in Hongkong for 2 days and then we
proceeded to Canton where we entrained for Hankow. Zung Yah
Shing had preceded us to Hankow. On arrival in Hankow the
party of 45 was divided into 2 parties one of 25 and one of
pages.zh:
Zeu Liang ( 趙良 )，别名 Zung Ts Zau (陳子超)
杭州                                      D.S. Bradley
                                              C.D.C.273

我叫 Zeu Lisng (趙良)，别名 Zung Ts Zau (陳子超)，
38 岁，军人，杭州人，居住在法租界巴德路（Rue Eugene Bard）旁的维丰坊 278 号。

在当前战事爆发前，我在南市的小东门明（Siau Toong Ming，音译）做了 12 年的纸箱制造工。

战事爆发后，我加入了一支在中国军队后方活动的便衣队，
并对抗日军作战，直到日军占领南市。

我与许多人成功从南市逃入法租界，在那里被法国当局
拘禁在罗伯特神父路（Rue Pere Robert）的法政学校。在被
拘禁 57 天后，我们获释，我与一些人前往位于阿尔巴斯特路（Alabaster Road）的藏公难民收容所，
在那里居住了约一个月。月底时，曾与我一同
担任便衣军人的 Zung Yah Shing（音译）来到难民收容所，告诉
我们中的一些人，我们在汉口对国家会更有用处，
他希望我们中的一些人愿意前往那里，如果我们同意，他将提供
交通工具。收容所中的 45 名难民，
包括我在内，同意接受 Zung Yah Shing 的提议，并于 1938 年 3 月 23 日，
乘坐英国轮船离开上海前往香港。我们在香港停留了 2 天，然后
前往广州，在那里换乘火车前往汉口。Zung Yah
Shing 已先于我们到达汉口。抵达汉口后，这 45 人的队伍
被分为两组，一组 25 人，另一组

pages.en:
(2)

Tseu Liang , alias Zung Ts Zeu

20. The party of 25 were detailed for duty in a military
hospital and the other party were detailed for military
service. I was in the party detailed for hospital work
and we worked there for 2 months and then 10 of our number
were detailed for special duty at Changsha. At about this
time Zung Yah Shing came to the hospital and informed myself
and 12 others that he wished us to accompany him to Shanghai
and he would provide the necessary means of travel.

Zung Yah Shing, the 12 others and myself were then spoken
to by Dan Lih, Chief of the Secret Service Dept. in Hankow
and he informed us that we were proceeding to Shanghai on a
secret mission and that we had to take all our orders from
Zung Yah Shing whom we were to obey implicitly.

The party left Hankow on a British Steamer which took
us to Kiukiang and from there we entrained for Chingwha
where we boarded a Chinese steamer bound for Ningpo. We then
travelled by a British Steamer from Ningpo to Shanghai and we
arrived at the French Bund on 2/5/38. We never carried
either bombs or firearms from Hankow. I was allowed $30.00
per month for expenses whilst I was in Shanghai and this
money was paid to me by Zung Yah Shing when I met him in the
French Park from time to time. We did not know Zung Yah Shings
residence but we had received instructions that when any
work was to be done we would receive a message from Tseu Seu
Keng who alone knew of Zung Yah Shing's whereabouts , and we
went to meet in the French Park at the time given by Tseu
Seu Keng. We met in the French Park on numerous occasions,
pages.zh:
(2)

Tseu Liang，别名 Zung Ts Zeu

20 人。25 人的那组被派往一家军事医院服役，
另一组则被派往军事部门服役。我在被派往医院工作的那组，
我们在那里工作了 2 个月，随后我们中有 10 人被派往长沙执行
特殊任务。大约在此时，Zung Yah Shing 来到医院，通知我和
其他 12 人，他希望我们陪同他前往上海，
并将提供必要的旅费。

随后，汉口秘密情报处处长 Dan Lih（音译）找
Zung Yah Shing、其他 12 人和我谈话，他通知我们，我们将前往上海执行
秘密任务，我们必须听从 Zung Yah Shing 的所有命令，并绝对服从他。

该小组乘坐一艘英国轮船离开汉口，轮船将我们
带到九江，从那里我们换乘火车前往清华（Chingwha，音译），
在那里登上一艘开往宁波的中国轮船。随后我们
乘坐英国轮船从宁波前往上海，并于 1938 年 5 月 2 日抵达法租界外滩。
我们从汉口出发时从未携带炸弹或枪支。在上海期间，
我每月获准报销 30.00 美元的费用，这笔钱
由 Zung Yah Shing 在我不时于法租界公园与他见面时支付给我。
我们不知道 Zung Yah Shing 的住处，但我们收到指示，当有
任务需要执行时，我们会收到来自 Tseu Seu Keng（音译）的消息，只有他知道 Zung Yah Shing 的下落，我们
便在 Tseu Seu Keng 指定的时间去法租界公园会面。我们多次在法租界公园会面，

pages.en:
(3)

Zou Lieng, alias Zung Ts Leu

mostly between 7 and 8 p.m. in the evening and Zung Yah Shing
discussed his plans only with the persons whom he was intend-
ing to utilise in his schemes.
I also met persons in the French Park who seemed to be
connected with Zung Yah Shing whom I had never met before.
When our party arrived in Shanghai Zung Yah Shing divided
us into groups and gave instructions where we were to reside
and I together with two others named Kong Kwei Sung and Zai Ts
Yue were told to open a room in the Yah Shing Lodging House,
Rue Du Montigny. I do not know where the remainder of the
party went to.
From time to time, Zung Yah Shing told us to change our
address and we complied. When we had taken a room at 12 Rue
Wagner we intended to live there for some time but after we
had been there only two weeks Zung Yah Shing sent for Zai
Ts Yue and took him away from us substituting Wong Ts Koo. I
do not remember the dates but some time later I learned from
the evening press that Zai Ts Yue had been killed in the
attempted assassination of Yae Choch Sung at Jinkee Road.
We then opened a room in the Dah Wah Boarding House, Rue
Auguste Boppe.
On 6/7/33 Wong Ts Koo, Kong Kwei Sung and myself were
ordered by Tseu Sen Kong to meet Zung Yah Shing in the French
Park between 7 and 8 p.m. 6/7/33 and received instructions.
We complied and when I met Zung Yah Shing in the French Park
he gave me a large mauser pistol and told me that he had given
a bomb to Lee Tsung Wei. Our instructions were that Lee Tsung
pages.zh:
(3)

Zou Lieng，别名 Zung Ts Leu

大多在晚上 7 点到 8 点之间，Zung Yah Shing
只与他打算在其计划中利用的人员讨论他的计划。
我也在法租界公园见过一些似乎与 Zung Yah Shing 有关联的人，
我以前从未见过他们。
当我们的小组抵达上海时，Zung Yah Shing 将我们
分成若干小组，并指示我们应该居住在哪里，
我和另外两名名叫 Kong Kwei Sung（音译）和 Zai Ts Yue（音译）的人被告知
在蒙梯尼路（Rue Du Montigny）的雅兴旅馆（Yah Shing Lodging House，音译）开一个房间。
我不知道其余的人去了哪里。
不时地，Zung Yah Shing 让我们更换地址，我们都照办了。
当我们在瓦格纳路 12 号租了一个房间后，我们打算在那里住一段时间，
但我们在那里只住了两周，Zung Yah Shing 就派人叫走了 Zai Ts Yue，
并用 Wong Ts Koo（音译）替换了他。我不记得具体日期，但
不久后我从晚报上得知，Zai Ts Yue 在江西路刺杀 Yae Choch Sung（音译）的未遂行动中丧生。
随后我们在奥古斯特·博佩路（Rue Auguste Boppe）的大华公寓（Dah Wah Boarding House，音译）开了一个房间。
1933 年 7 月 6 日，Wong Ts Koo、Kong Kwei Sung 和我奉 Tseu Sen Kong（音译）之命，
于 1933 年 7 月 6 日晚上 7 点至 8 点在法租界公园与 Zung Yah Shing 会面并接受指令。
我们照办了，当我在法租界公园见到 Zung Yah Shing 时，
他给了我一支大号毛瑟手枪，并告诉我他已经给了 Lee Tsung Wei（音译）一枚炸弹。我们的指令是 Lee Tsung

pages.en:
(4)

Zau Liung, alias Zung Ts Zau

Whei and I should proceed to the Settlement Boundary in the
West Hongkew District in the early morning of 7/7/38 and Lee
was to throw his bomb at a Japanese sentry and I was to cover
up his escape by using the mauser pistol if necessary. I do
not know what instructions were given by Zung Yah Shing to the
remainder of the party but I know that it had been decided by
Zung Yah Shing to create a number of incidents on the anniver-
sary of the opening of hostilities. I knew that Kong Kwei Sung
had received a bomb from Zung Yah Shing, because Lee Tsung Whei
Kong Kwei Sung and myself proceeded from the French Park to
our lodgings at Rue Auguste Boppe and cached the two bombs and
the pistol. After we had cached the weapons we proceeded to
the Chung Nan Hotel, Avenue Edward VII where we had opened a
room on the 3rd. floor for the purpose of playing Mah Jong
until the time for proceeding on our missions.

Six persons occupied the room in the Chung Nan during
the night of 6/7/38 and from the conversation I learnt that
all six in the room had received instructions and weapons
from Zung Yah Shing. The six persons were as follows:-
Lee Tsung Whei (李春輝)
Wang Kwang Sen (王光才)
Sung Kai Kwang (陳開光)
Ching Yoong Sang (冷榮生)
Kong Kwei Sung (江桂生)
Myself

None of us had any weapons in the room at the Chung Nan Lodging
House and at about 4.30 a.m. on the 7/7/38 we left the Chung
pages.zh:
(4)

赵良，又名孙次赵

韦和我应于1938年7月7日清晨前往虹口区西部的租界边界，李将向一名日本哨兵投掷炸弹，如有必要，我将使用毛瑟手枪掩护其撤离。我不知道孙亚兴给其余同伙下达了什么指令，但我知道孙亚兴已决定在战事爆发周年纪念日制造多起事件。我知道江桂生从孙亚兴处收到了一枚炸弹，因为李宗维、江桂生和我从法国公园前往我们在奥古斯特·博佩路（Rue Auguste Boppe）的住所，藏匿了两枚炸弹和那把手枪。藏好武器后，我们前往爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）的中南旅馆，我们在三楼开了一间房，目的是在那里打麻将，直到执行任务的时间到来。

1938年7月6日晚，六人住在中南旅馆的房间内，从谈话中我得知，房间内的六人均从孙亚兴处接受了指令并领取了武器。这六人如下：
李宗维 (李春輝)
王光才 (王光才)
陈开光 (陳開光)
冷荣生 (冷榮生)
江桂生 (江桂生)
我自己

在中南旅馆住宿期间，我们房间内没有任何武器，1938年7月7日凌晨约4点30分，我们离开中南

pages.en:
(5)

Zau Liang, alias Zung Ts Zau

Nan Hotel and proceeded to the places in Frenchtown where
our weapons were cached. Lee Tsung Whei and I proceeded by
ricsha to Rue Auguste Boppe and secured our weapons and then
we again used ricshas to proceed to North Chekiang Road near
Haining Road where we alighted and walked on foot to the
Settlement Boundary on Haining Road.

At exactly 6 a.m. Lee Tsung Whei threw the bomb at a
Japanese sentry who was on duty at the Haining Road extension
and we ran away towards North Chekiang Road without waiting
to see the result. On arrival at North Chekiang Road we
called two ricshas and travelled in them to the Pak Si Jao
Market, Frenchtown via Tsepoo Road and Fokien Road.

We had been instructed by Zung Yah Shing to meet him
at the Pak Si Jsu **〔此处转录不清〕** and report the result of our mission.
We met Zung Yah Shing as arranged and I handed him the mauser
pistol and then Lee Tsung Whei and myself went to a nearby
teashop to await the remainder of the party. We learned that
Kong Kwei Sung had been arrested therefore we did not return
to Rue Auguste Boppe.

I was instructed by Zung Yah Shing to rent a room at
276 Wei Pung Fong off Rue Eugene Bard and then he sent
Zung Kan Kwung and Zung Kan Yuin to live with me at the
mentioned address.

I know that Zung Yah Shing called Zung Kan Kwung and
Zung Kan Yuin to see him on 20/7/38 but I do not know why.
I know nothing of the assassination of Duang Yoch Foo by
Zung Kan Kwung on 22/7/38 as I have already stated that
pages.zh:
(5)

赵良，又名孙次赵

旅馆，前往法租界内我们藏匿武器的地点。李宗维和我乘人力车前往奥古斯特·博佩路，取回我们的武器，然后再次乘坐人力车前往靠近海宁路的北浙江路，我们下车后步行至海宁路上的租界边界。

上午6点整，李宗维向在海宁路延伸段执勤的一名日本哨兵投掷了炸弹，我们没有等待查看结果便向北浙江路方向逃跑。到达北浙江路后，我们叫了两辆人力车，经乍浦路和福建路前往法租界的百西桥市场。

孙亚兴指示我们在百西桥**〔此处转录不清〕**与他见面，汇报任务结果。我们按约定见到了孙亚兴，我将毛瑟手枪交给他，随后李宗维和我前往附近的一家茶馆，等待其余同伙。我们得知江桂生已被捕，因此我们没有返回奥古斯特·博佩路。

孙亚兴指示我在欧仁·巴尔路（Rue Eugene Bard）旁的魏平坊276号租一个房间，随后他派孙干光和孙干云到上述地址与我同住。

我知道孙亚兴于1938年7月20日召见孙干光和孙干云，但我不知道原因。我对孙干光于1938年7月22日刺杀杜耀福一事一无所知，因为我已陈述过

(6)

Zeu Liang, alias Zung Ts Zeu

Zung Yah Shing only let the persons whom he wished to utilise
know his plans.

I was arrested by detectives at No.1 lane 241 Route des
Soeurs, when I called there to visit Lee Tsung Wei.

All of our party lived in Frenchtown and at no time did
we reside in the Settlement.

The names of the party that travelled from Hankow to

赵良，又名孙次邹

孙亚兴只让他打算利用的人知道他的计划。

我在姐妹会路（Route des Soeurs）241弄1号拜访李宗维时，被侦探逮捕。

我们要所有成员都住在法租界，从未在公共租界居住过。

(7)

Zau Liang, alias Zung Ts Zau

party but I know that Zung Yah Shing is the brains of the
party and he knows what the various members have done as he

(Sgd.) Zau Liang
pages.zh:
(7)

赵良，又名孙次赵

但我知道孙亚兴是该组织的智囊，他知道各个成员做了什么，因为他给他们下达了指令。

（签名）赵良

pages.en:
Wong Ts Koo (王志固)
Ningpo                                      D.S. Rhodes
Headquarters            27-7-38             C.D.C. 273

My name is Wong Ts Koo (王志固), alias Wong Ming Tuh
(王明德), alias Wong Ts Ching (王志堅) aged 23, native
of Ningpo residing at No.276 Rue Eugene Bard, French Concession.

I was born during the eight moon on the 19th. day (1915)
in Cheu Keu village in the Chekiang Province, my father at that
time being a captain in the 1st. Army Group of the Republican
Army.

At the age of 9 years I commenced to study at the Woo Ling
School which was situated in the Cheu Keu village, Ningpo and
**〔此处转录不清〕**at this school until the age of 16 years, when I went
to the Nanking Middle School at Nanking where I studied for
three years at the end of which **〔此处转录不清〕**I through the introduction
of my uncle came to Shanghai and was apprenticed to a machine
factory known as the Hung Tsang Ziang situated in Pootung. I
lived on the premises. I remained at the machine works, Pootung
until the out break of the present Sino-Japanese hostilities
August 1937, when I saw an advertisement in the newspapers
asking for volunteers to join the China Young Men's Anti-
Japanese Society I answered the advertisement and went to
Hwei Ti Hieu, Nantao and became a member of the Society and
was posted to a group under the Command of Sung Yah Shing
(          ). Most of the time was spent in **〔此处转录不清〕**lectures
and spreading anti "Japanese" propaganda, although on occasions
we were sent to Nanking digging trenches. After three months
I returned to Ningpo due to **〔此处转录不清〕**health.

I remained at home until March, 1938 when I went to Hankow
to visit my uncle named Wang & Hsu (王士克) who is employed
pages.zh:
王志固 (王志固)
宁波                                      D.S. Rhodes
总部                    1938年7月27日     C.D.C. 273

我叫王志固 (王志固)，又名王明德 (王明德)，又名王志坚 (王志堅)，现年23岁，宁波人，居住在法租界欧仁·巴尔路276号。

我出生于民国四年（1915年）农历八月十九日，出生地为浙江省朱家村，当时我的父亲是国民革命军第一集团军的一名连长。

9岁时，我开始在位于宁波朱家村的武岭学校读书，并在该校就读至16岁，之后我前往南京的南京中学，在那里学习了三年，期满后**〔此处转录不清〕**通过叔叔的介绍来到上海，在浦东一家名为“洪长兴”的机器厂当学徒。我住在厂里。我一直待在浦东的机器厂，直到1937年8月中日战事爆发，当时我在报纸上看到一则招募志愿者加入“中国青年抗日救国会”的广告。我响应了广告，前往南市惠蒂学社，成为该会会员，并被分配到孙亚兴 (          ) 指挥的一个小组。大部分时间用于**〔此处转录不清〕**讲座和传播反“日”宣传，尽管有时我们会被派往南京挖战壕。三个月后，我因**〔此处转录不清〕**健康原因返回宁波。

我待在家里直到1938年3月，当时我前往汉口探望我的叔叔王士克 (王士克)，他受雇

pages.en:
(2)

Veng Ts Koo

as chief bodyguard to Chiang-kai-shek (蒋介石).
After about two weeks in Hankow I accidently met Sung
Yah Shing on the street in the Japanese Concession who then
informed me that he had an office also in the Japanese Con-
cession from where he directed anti-Japanese propaganda work.
After my first accidental meeting with Sung Yah Shing
I occasionally visited him at his office and he informed
me that he intended to form a guerrilla band and proceed to
Shanghai, I agreed to join him. On or about 25th. April, 1938
a party of fourteen including myself under the command of Sung
Yah Shing left Hankow, proceeded by boat to Kiukiang thence
to Chin Hua, Chekiang by train, and to Ningpo by boat and
finally from Ningpo to Shanghai via the "King Teh" (英泰)
(British ship) arriving about 3rd. May 1938.
Sung Yah Shing did not accompany me to Shanghai, he leav-
ing the boat at Ningpo. Arriving at Shanghai, I Tseu Van Yoong
(周维莹) (arrested) and Ngai Tsung Pang (颜振邦) proceed-
ed to the Dong Shing Kang (同兴公) lodging house, Fukien
Road, whilst the remainder of the gang saw ten men went to
**〔此处转录不清〕**
Before leaving Sung Yah Shing instructed me to meet him
at 10 a.m. two days after my arrival at Jubilee Hall.
I kept this appointment with Sung Yah Shing who told
me that I was to hire a room for my party and then report
to him any day at 3 p.m. in the Y.M.C.A., 169 Nanking
Road.
pages.zh:
(2)

王志固

担任蒋介石 (蒋介石) 的首席保镖。
在汉口大约两周后，我在日租界的街上偶然遇到了孙亚兴，他当时告诉我，他在日租界也有一个办事处，从那里指挥反日宣传工作。
在与孙亚兴第一次偶然相遇后，我偶尔去他的办公室拜访他，他告诉我他打算组建一支游击队并前往上海，我同意加入他。1938年4月25日左右，包括我在内的十四人一行在孙亚兴的指挥下离开汉口，乘船前往九江，然后乘火车前往浙江金华，再乘船前往宁波，最后从宁波乘坐“英泰”号（英国轮船）前往上海，于1938年5月3日左右抵达。
孙亚兴没有陪我到上海，他在宁波下了船。抵达上海后，我和周维莹 (周维莹)（已被捕）以及颜振邦 (颜振邦) 前往福建路的同兴公旅馆，而其余团伙成员中的十人去了**〔此处转录不清〕**
离开前，孙亚兴指示我抵达两天后上午10点在 Jubilee Hall 与他见面。
我履行了与孙亚兴的约会，他告诉我，我要为我的同伙租一个房间，然后每天下午3点在南京路169号的青年会向他汇报。

pages.en:
(3)

Wong Ts Koo

I was unable to secure rooms at once, but after three
days I removed to the Woo Zung (華盛) lodging house, Route
Voison, French Concession and I reported my whereabouts to
Sung Yah Shing who ordered me to stay there and await instruc-
tions.

Meanwhile just prior to leaving the Dong Shing Kung
lodging house, Fokien Road, Ngai Tsung Pang left my party
and absconded, he was replaced **〔此处转录不清〕** Wong Kwaung Zai (王芝才)
sent by Sung Yah Shing.

I and my two companions remained at the Woo Zung (華盛)
lodging house for about one month during which time Sung Yah
Shing visited me frequently and supplied me with $30.00 per
month wages.

At the end of one month Sung Yah Shing instructed me
to change my address and at the same time he took away my
companions Wong Kwaung Zai and Tseu Van Yoong and replaced
them by Zeu Liang (趙良) and Kieng Hai Sung (江梅生).
We moved to the Sing Ziang (新祥) lodging house, Route Galle
and occupied room No.5. I stayed at this place for three
weeks and Sung Yah Shing visited me frequently, and advised
me to watch my companions whom he did not trust too much.
About 10/6/38 I left the Sing Ziang lodging house because
Tseu Van Yoong (周維榮) my former companion had been arrested
by Police following the attempted assassination of Yeu Chih
Sung (尤菊蓀) on the Bund and Jinkoo Road corner, and I
was afraid Police enquiries would eventually lead to my address,
therefore I went to the Dah Wah Lodging House No.47 Rue Auguste
pages.zh:
(3)

王志固

我无法立即找到房间，但三天后我搬到了法租界华盛旅馆（Woo Zung），位于Voison路，并向孙亚兴报告了我的行踪，他命令我留在那里等待指令。

与此同时，就在离开福建路同兴公旅馆之前，颜振邦离开了我的队伍并潜逃，孙亚兴派来的王芝才 (王芝才) **〔此处转录不清〕**替换了他。

我和我的两名同伴在华盛旅馆住了大约一个月，在此期间，孙亚兴经常来看望我，并每月给我30美元的工资。

一个月后，孙亚兴指示我更换住址，同时带走了我的同伴王芝才和周维莹，换成了赵良 (趙良) 和江梅生 (江梅生)。我们搬到了加乐路（Route Galle）的新祥旅馆，入住了5号房间。我在那里住了三周，孙亚兴经常来看望我，并建议我监视我的同伴，因为他不太信任他们。1938年6月10日左右，我离开了新祥旅馆，因为我以前的同伴周维荣 (周維榮) 在外滩与金陵路拐角处刺杀尤菊蓀 (尤菊蓀) 未遂后被警察逮捕，我担心警方的调查最终会查到我的住址，因此我去了奥古斯特·博佩路47号的大华旅馆
